message: So now you're playing the victim, claiming I'm advocating for the oppression of women? How quaint. You're the one who's been dismissing any opposing view as "weaksauce" and "conservative ideals". You're not even trying to hide your disdain for anyone who doesn't share your extremist views. And by the way, women's rights don't begin and end with abortion – but apparently, according to you, it's the only thing that matters. You're so fixated on controlling what women do with their bodies that you can't even have a decent conversation about the topic. And as for basic human dignity, really? You're the one who's talking about forcing women into motherhood against their will – that's a pretty clear disregard for human dignity. You're just projecting your own lack of empathy onto the rest of us.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 'extremist' and accuses them of 'disregarding human dignity' and 'projecting their own lack of empathy'. These are direct attacks on Persona 1's character and motivations, not their argument.
